guidances.libelle: Part du chiffre d'affaires net total et du résultat avant impôt des segments com
guidances.citation: Pawn operations remain the primary earnings driver as the Company expects the combined U.S., Latin America and U.K. pawn segments to be approximately 90% of total net revenue and segment level pre-tax income for 2026.

guidances.libelle: Croissance des ventes au détail aux États-Unis
guidances.citation: retail sales growth of approximately 8% to 10% for the quarter.

guidances.libelle: Augmentation des dépenses d'exploitation en Amérique latine
guidances.citation: operating expenses are expected to increase 10% to 12%.

guidances.libelle: Augmentation des dépenses d'exploitation au Royaume-Uni
guidances.citation: Operating expenses are expected to increase approximately 10% driven in part by new store additions in 2026.
Net revenue (after depreciation of leased merchandise and lease and loan loss provisioning) is expected to decrease 15% to 20% for the fourth quarter
while interest expense for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to increase approximately 5% over the prior-year quarter assuming current interest rates.
